description: The bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized as "Untargeted", "Targets", and another unspecified category, across various years from 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the years, labeled in a chronological order from 2012 to 2022, while the vertical axis is labeled "Number of datasets" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, marked at intervals of 20. Each year is represented by a grouped set of three bars, colored blue, orange, and grey, corresponding to "Untargeted", another category, and "Targets", respectively, as indicated by the legend. The height of the bars varies across the years, with the orange bars being generally taller than the blue and grey bars; for instance, in 2021, the orange bar reaches approximately 155, while the blue bar is around 65 and the grey bar is at 0. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and there is no visual emphasis on any specific bar. The chart displays a general increasing trend in the number of datasets across the years for the orange and blue categories, with the orange category consistently having more datasets than the blue and grey categories.
